{{Conjecture|legends}}
Around [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]], [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Kentor Sarne]] initiated a series of '''incursions''' into the [[Minos Cluster/Legends|Minos Cluster]] from his holdings in the neighboring [[Kathol sector/Legends|Kathol sector]]. Despite being outnumbered, Sarne's [[Moff Sarne's forces|forces]] managed to emerge victorious, capturing and holding territory. Rumors had reached the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] that the Moff had gained access to a [[DarkStryder technology|new form of weapons technology]], and it was surmised that this gave his military the edge during battle. The New Republic managed to [[Minos Cluster counterattack|push]] Sarne's forces back to the Kathol sector.
